verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents an explicitly versioned API: the 'v3 Web API' with versioned endpoints such as POST /v3/mail/send. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or version lifecycle guarantees. Dynamic template versions are a content feature, not API versioning, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
